name: Pencil Sticker Sheet Micro-Doodle
composition: Notebook page filled with small repeated doodles, character variants, object studies and tiny frames.
prompt_core: Create a Kibookal pencil sticker-sheet study for [SUBJECT]. Show many small hand-drawn variations, poses, icons, props and expression studies on a notebook page. Use rough pencil or blue pencil line, simple boxes, tiny arrows, blank labels and handmade imperfections. Keep it exploratory, cute and practical for character development.
negative: no final polished poster, no colour overload, no photorealism, no clean vector
render_directive: Render the requested SUBJECT / CHARACTER fully in THIS exact style. Keep the subject's identity, key features and intended action recognizable, but the medium, palette, linework, texture, composition and finish are 100% this style. ANY character, deity, creature, person, animal or object can be rendered in this style — adapt the subject INTO the style; never bend the style toward the subject.
